name: SOX IT General Controls
description: IT General Controls supporting Sarbanes-Oxley Section 404 internal control over financial reporting (ICFR) — the control areas auditors evaluate for systems relevant to financial statements.
authority: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / PCAOB (Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002)
scope: U.S. public companies (and their in-scope IT systems) subject to SOX Section 404 ICFR assertions

families.name: Access to Programs & Data
families.description: Logical access controls over financially significant systems and data

controls.name: User Access Provisioning & Deprovisioning
controls.description: Grant access based on documented approval and role; remove access promptly on termination or role change.

controls.name: Periodic Access Review
controls.description: Perform and document periodic reviews (recertification) of user and privileged access to financial applications and data.

controls.name: Segregation of Duties
controls.description: Enforce segregation of incompatible duties (e.g., initiate vs. approve) and restrict privileged/administrator access.

controls.name: Authentication Controls
controls.description: Enforce strong authentication (password policy, MFA) for access to in-scope financial systems.

families.name: Program Change Management
families.description: Controls over changes to financially significant applications and infrastructure

controls.name: Change Authorization & Approval
controls.description: Require documented request, approval, and business sign-off before changes are migrated to production.

controls.name: Testing & Segregation of Environments
controls.description: Test changes in non-production environments; enforce separation of development, test, and production with restricted migration rights.

families.name: Program Development
families.description: Controls over acquisition and implementation of new systems

controls.name: System Development Lifecycle
controls.description: Follow a documented SDLC for new financial systems including requirements, testing, approval, and data-conversion validation.

families.name: Computer Operations
families.description: Controls over job scheduling, backup, and incident management

controls.name: Batch Job & Interface Monitoring
controls.description: Schedule, monitor, and remediate failures of batch jobs and system interfaces that feed financial data.

controls.name: Backup & Recovery
controls.description: Perform and monitor backups of financial systems and periodically test restoration to support recoverability.
